goal: Die vollständige browserlokale Preview-Matrix Desktop 1152 px, Tablet 768 px und Schmal 360 px gemeinsam in realem Chromium auf Fokus, Umschaltung, Beschriftung, Overflow und Inhaltskonsistenz abnehmen. Nur reproduzierbare Befunde dürfen Runtime-Code verändern.

guide_delta.summary: I142 ergänzt reale Chromium-Evidence für alle drei Preview-Modi. Es wird kein neuer Produktpunkt eingeführt; der A-M-Fortschritt bleibt 28 von 132.

direct_dependencies: I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: run real Chromium preview matrix evidence
keyboard activation retains focus on the selected preview mode button
exactly one preview mode button exposes aria-pressed=true
labels and semantic width descriptions match 1152/768/360 contracts
preview content remains byte-equivalent in visible text across viewport switches
document itself has no horizontal overflow
desktop/tablet overflow remains confined to preview shell
rendered preview width matches the mode contract
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because I142 is a focused acceptance/evidence iteration
risks: mode switching could lose keyboard focus
aria-pressed could drift from visible mode state
wide viewports could leak horizontal overflow to the whole document
preview content could accidentally vary by viewport
acceptance must not silently become a feature expansion
non_changes: no runtime change unless real Chromium evidence exposes a reproducible defect
no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: runtime/iteration-0142/preview-matrix-evidence.json is created during the evidence run
Desktop/Tablet/Schmal receive a shared real-browser acceptance
